scope_limits: No actual school Slurm query, sbatch, scancel, GPU operation, remoteGitHub write or live process termination occurred in this review.
Existing job observations and process identities/signals use explicit fixtures; they do not prove that the school controller or uploader is currently ready.
A ready sidecar receipt confirms patched management code and required lock/observation acknowledgement, not finished remote uploads or all fourGPU allocations.
Repair patches newly started management processes in memory; existing scientific worker processes, mathematical code, checkpoints, plan and scientific result seals are untouched.
The bounded reader removes the reproduced oversized-read allocation and verified-plan duplication; it cannot guarantee absence of every future memory exhaustion.
BinaryA contents are explicitly encoded transport files. Original-byte identity holds after declared strictbase64 reconstruction; independentB remains the original raw archive.
Network failures still require normal independent retry and remote acknowledgements before any upload completion claim.
